source.citation: John Carbutt, '70. Lake street, East from Clark.' Stereograph from Carbutt's Views of Chicago, c. 1866-1871. New York Public Library, Robert N. Dennis collection of stereoscopic views, 'Stereoscopic views of streets in Chicago', MFY Dennis Coll 90-F179 (digital ID G90F179 027F).
what_it_does_not_supply: the identity, width or height of any generated front

segmental and round-headed windows with hoods, bracketed cornices, painted signboards and wall lettering, awnings
